Dental Receptionist (Full-time)

Bright Smile Dental is a fictional, friendly family practice with four dentists and a team of 15. We have served our neighbourhood for over 20 years and we love what we do.

About the role: You are the first face our patients see. You'll keep the day running smoothly so our dentists can focus on care.

You will:
1. Welcome patients in person and on the phone, book and confirm appointments
2. Manage the schedule in Dentrix and fill last-minute openings
3. Explain treatment costs and process insurance claims and payments
4. Keep patient records private and up to date
5. Calm nervous patients and handle the occasional upset caller with care

You bring:
1. 1+ year in a front-desk, reception or customer service role
2. Confident on the phone and with computers; Dentrix or another practice system is a plus
3. Strong attention to detail with numbers and insurance forms
4. A warm, patient manner
5. Available some Saturdays

We offer: paid vacation, dental coverage for you and your family, and a 4-day work week option.
